flow.title: Access
flow.description: A protected entry boundary accepts the asset universe, objective, and a supported forecast horizon.

flow.title: As-of resolution
flow.description: One latest-complete cutoff is resolved against the separate observation requirements of both algorithms.

flow.title: Calibration
flow.description: Historical A/B forecasts and result-window prices are prepared through independent branches; only complete pairs with mature labels enter the request-specific sample.

flow.title: Forecast
flow.description: Independent A and B services receive separate point-in-time bundles under one fixed Forecast Context.

flow.title: COSMOS
flow.description: The complete current A/B pair and request-specific weights are combined into a joint distribution.

flow.title: Portfolio
flow.description: The optimizer receives the joint distribution and request constraints; only the final portfolio crosses the response boundary.

domains.title: Portfolio Experience
domains.purpose: Own the protected request and final-response boundary without persisting a portfolio request.

components.title: Portfolio Console
components.responsibility: Collect the asset scope, objective, and common supported horizon; display only the final portfolio.

components.title: Portfolio Request API
components.responsibility: Validate the compatibility manifest, pin the Forecast Context, and return only the final result.

domains.title: Data & Evidence
domains.purpose: Assemble algorithm-specific point-in-time evidence and provide normalized price series through one internally owned source path.

components.title: Evidence Assembly Service
components.responsibility: Resolve readiness, plan source access, and assemble separate A/B bundles at one compatible cutoff.

components.title: Market Price Service
components.responsibility: Own the FSC price path; normalize price series and report interval coverage or readiness without calculating returns.

components.title: DART Source Connector
components.responsibility: Collect, parse, clean, and split disclosure responses only when requested by Evidence Assembly.

components.title: FSC Stock Price Connector
components.responsibility: Collect FSC daily-price responses only when invoked by Market Price Service; do not calculate returns.

components.title: Exact Data Plane Service
components.responsibility: Prepare structured disclosure data as Exact Evidence without normalizing prices or calculating returns.

components.title: Shared Evidence Encoder Service
components.responsibility: Run only the common source encoder and produce Shared Latent Evidence; algorithm-specific decoding stays inside A/B.

components.title: Request-Scoped Data Workspace
components.responsibility: Reuse compatible source responses, normalized prices, shared encoder outputs, and in-progress evidence within one request only.

domains.title: Algorithm Services
domains.purpose: Execute purpose-independent A/B forecasts under the same immutable Forecast Context.

components.title: Conclusion Request Gateway
components.responsibility: Accept current or historical contexts and return a complete A/B pair or an explicit failure.

components.title: Algorithm Evidence Coordinator
components.responsibility: Query separate requirements, coordinate the common cutoff, and deliver each bundle to its owning algorithm.

components.title: Algorithm A Service
components.responsibility: Own A observation requirements and map its fixed context plus evidence bundle to Conclusion A.

children.title: Embedded Decoder A
children.responsibility: Interpret Shared Latent and Exact Evidence inside the pinned Algorithm A service version.

children.title: Forecast Function A
children.responsibility: Produce Conclusion A for the requested As-of and horizon without reading the portfolio objective.

components.title: Algorithm B Service
components.responsibility: Own B observation requirements and map its fixed context plus evidence bundle to Conclusion B.

children.title: Embedded Decoder B
children.responsibility: Interpret Shared Latent and Exact Evidence inside the pinned Algorithm B service version.

children.title: Forecast Function B
children.responsibility: Produce Conclusion B for the requested As-of and horizon without reading the portfolio objective.

domains.title: Algorithm Weight Calibration
domains.purpose: Re-estimate A/B weights for each portfolio request from complete historical samples under pinned versions.

components.title: Calibration Runner
components.responsibility: Replay historical contexts and admit only complete A/B pairs whose outcome interval has matured.

components.title: Historical Return Evaluator
components.responsibility: Request normalized historical prices only through Market Price Service and return a mature realized return or an invalid sample.

components.title: Weight Optimizer
components.responsibility: Score candidate weights against complete samples for the current asset scope and horizon.

domains.title: Decision & Portfolio
domains.purpose: Coordinate context resolution, calibration, the current forecast, distribution combination, and final optimization.

components.title: Decision Request Coordinator
components.responsibility: Provide the single entry and exit for the decision boundary; direct access to source data is forbidden.

components.title: COSMOS Distribution Service
components.responsibility: Combine time- and version-compatible A/B conclusions with request-specific weights.

components.title: Portfolio Optimization Service
components.responsibility: Calculate the final portfolio from the joint distribution and request objective or constraints.

contracts.title: Immutable Forecast Context
contracts.rule: Asset universe, forecast horizon, resolved common As-of, and compatibility-manifest versions are pinned before calibration or current inference.

contracts.title: Separate A/B evidence
contracts.rule: Observation requirements and bundle requests are never merged; each algorithm receives only its own evidence contract.

contracts.title: Complete pair or fail
contracts.rule: Every current or historical As-of returns both conclusions or a failure; partial pairs never enter COSMOS or calibration.

contracts.title: One price path
contracts.rule: Market Price Service is the sole internal owner of FSC price access; Historical Return Evaluator obtains normalized historical prices only through that service.

contracts.title: Mature labels only
contracts.rule: A historical sample is eligible only after the full outcome interval has ended and the realized return is available.

contracts.title: Anti-lookahead reuse
contracts.rule: A response prepared at a later cutoff cannot satisfy an earlier As-of, even inside the same request.

contracts.title: Request-scoped cleanup
contracts.rule: Temporary responses, evidence, and returns are removed on request completion, failure, or timeout and are not reused across requests.

lifecycle.reuseBoundary: Same request, compatible source query and cutoff
Same request, compatible time boundary and price-query scope
Same request, same algorithm contract and Forecast Context
Matching target, Historical As-of, horizon, and current cutoff inside one request
lifecycle.cleanup: Consumed by the matching sample; no workspace or cross-request persistence

lifecycle.reuseBoundary: Exact target, horizon, As-of, and pinned versions
lifecycle.cleanup: No cross-request persistence in the model

deployments.title: Portfolio Experience Project
deployments.purpose: Isolate Portfolio Console and Portfolio Request API; ingress, authentication, and deployment automation remain outside the model.

deployments.title: Data & Evidence Project
deployments.purpose: Isolate DART evidence preparation, FSC price normalization, shared encoding, and the request-scoped workspace.

deployments.title: Algorithm Runtime Project
deployments.purpose: Evidence coordination and independent Algorithm A/B plugin execution.

deployments.title: Algorithm Weight Calibration Project
deployments.purpose: Isolate historical sample assembly, Historical Return Evaluator, and request-scoped weight optimization.

deployments.title: Portfolio Decision Project
deployments.purpose: Decision coordination, COSMOS distribution combination, and portfolio optimization.

failureConditions: No common latest-complete As-of satisfies both independent observation contracts.
Either current Algorithm A or Algorithm B conclusion is missing or incompatible.
The calibration window contains fewer than the configured minimum complete, mature samples.
The requested horizon is absent from the pinned compatibility manifest.
Historical price coverage is incomplete or the result window is not mature for enough calibration samples.
A source response, normalized price series, evidence bundle, return, or conclusion crosses its permitted time or request boundary.
The optimizer cannot produce a result that satisfies the request constraints.

outOfScope: Algorithm A and B financial logic
Named GCP products and production topology
